learning_objective: 🎯 To learn about the incredible healing powers of the Neem tree and understand why we must protect our natural environment!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Neem Baba is not a person, but a wise and old Neem tree in the village. Everyone respects him because he is like a giant, leafy doctor!
Every part of Neem Baba is useful. His leaves can cure skin problems, his bark heals fevers, and his twigs are used to keep teeth strong and clean.
Even though Neem leaves taste very bitter, they are pure magic for our health. It shows that sometimes things that are tough at first are actually very good for us!
The village learns that trees like Neem Baba take care of humans without asking for anything in return, so it is our duty to protect and water them.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Nature Hunt!
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your home or a nearby shop and try to find at least two things like soap or toothpaste that have Neem in them!

quick_recap: ⭐ The Neem tree is affectionately called Neem Baba because of its wisdom and age.
⭐ All parts of the Neem tree have amazing medicinal uses.
⭐ Neem twigs are used for brushing teeth and leaves for skin cures.
⭐ The story teaches us to respect and protect useful trees in our environment.
